exposure: biological anti-rheumatic agents (etanercept, adalimumab, infliximab, certolizumab-pegol, rituximab, golimumab, anakinra, abatacept)
outcome: obstetric outcomes (live births, spontaneous pregnancy loss)
cohort: The study included 67 women with various rheumatic diseases and peripheral chronic arthritis, accounting for 79 pregnancies exposed to biological agents during the periconceptional period or pregnancy.
finding: TNF-alpha inhibitors are considered safe during the periconception period for women with chronic arthritis, with a 66% live birth rate, 20% spontaneous pregnancy loss rate, and a low incidence of congenital malformations (one reported case).
